userRequest: Refaire l’intérieur pour correspondre à la direction artistique générale du Quartier ; conserver les planches botaniques approuvées.
direction: Salle en coupe, vue légèrement plongeante ; pierre crème, bois miel texturé, détails encrés fins, accents teal/ardoise, hortensias. Trois postes entièrement visibles dans la petite architecture du village.

interior.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / architectural cutaway. EDIT the school building in reference image2 into an OPEN ROOFLESS INTERIOR game location, using image1 as exact art-direction master. These two references define the art; do not use any earlier generated interior. Output landscape1536x1024. The entire composition is a miniature schoolroom seen from ABOVE at about35degrees, three-quarter view, with the FRONT WALL AND ROOF REMOVED, like an open dollhouse cutaway from this exact village game. Show the two rear walls meeting in a visible corner, thick irregular cream stone wall edges, floor footprint seen in perspective, no ceiling overhead. Architecture must have the same compact whimsical handmade proportions as the actual school building and map. Leave clear cream parchment margin at the bottom and thin margins around the open room. Every furniture object is shown whole and small within the room, with plenty of visible floor. Three obvious functional stations spread left, centre, right: LEFT a natural oak bookshelf against wall plus an angled reading lectern with open cream botanical herbarium; CENTRE a compact wooden school desk, blank quiz sheet, pencil, chair and small globe; RIGHT an oak workbench with seed trays, small wooden crossword board, magnifier, hemp rope/fabric. One small arched teal window at the back, blue hydrangea visible outside. A SMALL brass lamp can hang from a simple narrow wooden cross-beam high in the centre, with plenty of surrounding plain stone. No other hanging decorations. Strong priority: MATCH THE MAP'S HAND-INKED CARTOON ART, NOT a realistic room. Medium irregular black outer contours, finer inked wood grain and internal details, gently shaded limited-color volumes, scattered hand stippling on cream walls, subtly grainy cream paper. Palette is cream walls, charcoal-grey slate accents, muted honey oak, deep teal touches, sage green, little brass gold. No bright orange walls/furniture, no bright acid greens. Use similar material detail and outline thickness as the map buildings at this resolution. Avoid photorealism, generic glossy3D, painterly fantasy, children's flat coloring-book poster, huge uniform marker lines, eye-level or frontal perspective, giant window or furniture cropped by frame. No text, letters, UI, buttons, labels or characters. Draw the room as an actual playable location in the reference village.

animation.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a registered animation clean plate for the attached 1536x1024 game room. Keep the EXACT canvas, camera, positions, colors, outlines, grain, architecture, furniture and every other pixel/element as close as possible to the input. Make ONLY TWO LOCAL removals: (1) remove the little golden hanging lamp near x770 y180, including its gold attachment ring below the wooden overhead beam, and naturally continue the same cream stone wall behind it. Keep the wood beam, beam's black metal fixture and all surrounding stones unchanged. (2) remove ONLY the open botanical book from the sloped wooden reading lectern at lower left (book approximately x180..380 y475..615); reveal the intact empty wooden sloped lectern reading surface underneath, matching the surrounding oak. Keep the lectern's base, legs and full rest/platform. Do NOT remove the bookshelf, books on bookshelf, plant, globe, desk, chair, window, workbench, crossword, trays or any other object. No new objects. No changes to light or shadows outside the two removal zones. Do not enlarge or move anything. This is not a new composition; it must align perfectly with the input image for layered animation. Output the same 1536x1024 full image, no text.
animation.processing: Registered cuts with true alpha, original painting outside two local removal masks; same pause, reduced-motion, visibility and error fallback. Export script contains the paths and regions.

preserved: All ten botanical course illustrations and thumbnails; courses, quiz data, rewards and database.

discardedDraft.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: replacement interior illustration for an EXISTING French village game. Input 1 is the EXACT MASTER ART DIRECTION: the current Quartier village map. Input 2 is the actual school building from that same map, a supporting architecture/material reference. Input 3 is the REJECTED old interior; preserve ONLY its three functional destinations, NOT its composition, palette saturation or chunky line style. Redraw the interior completely to look unambiguously drawn by the same illustrator as input 1 and to belong inside input 2. Deliver ONE full-width landscape 1536x1024 image, no text, no lettering, no UI, no button plates. Show a charming Breton stone schoolroom from a slightly elevated three-quarter/isometric-like game camera (as on the map), with the front wall opened away, two cream limestone walls, a modest visible timber beam, natural honey-oak plank floor. Three distinct usable areas distributed left to right: at left a modest OAK bookcase with small teal/ochre book spines and an open botanical herbarium on a reading desk; at center a small school desk with blank cream quiz sheets, pencil, chair, a globe beside it; at right a workbench with seed sample trays, hemp cord and fabric, hand lens and a small wooden crossword tile board. Clear foreground space and separation, whole furniture visible. Small arched teal-painted window in back wall, a glimpse of blue hydrangeas and grey slate from the village outside. One modest brass hanging pendant lamp at upper centre with its chain attached to the beam; leave space around it so its silhouette can be animated. The open book at left must also have a clean distinct silhouette. ART MATCH: copy the map's restrained dark ink contour weights (fine interior details and medium silhouette outlines, NOT giant uniform marker lines), gently irregular handcrafted geometry, wood grain and plank joints, softly shaded volume, delicate stipple/hatching on cream stones and warm paper grain, restrained slate charcoal, deep petrol teal and muted natural golden oak. Use the exact map's illustrated game-object aesthetic and gentle daylight; it is a hand-painted inked village game, not glossy 3D. Natural wood should be muted warm tan as on the map, NEVER large bright orange panels. Keep a calm readable density with room to breathe. No fisheye, no frontal doll-like poster, no oversized black contours, no pink flower pots, no unrelated decorative clutter, no flat vector clipart, no photorealism. The camera and every material must clearly connect to the map reference. No people and no writing anywhere. Existing botanical educational plates are separate assets and must not be redesigned.
